title: Introduce tiered trace prioritizer and latency-credit rollup
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Adds a tiered trace prioritizer that probabilistically boosts sampling for high-latency/high-cost paths and a latency-credit rollup for fair burst handling. Includes dashboards and tuned alerts. Backwards compatible toggle via runtime flag.
description: Motivation: noise from low-value traces and uneven sampling causes observability blind spots during bursts. This PR introduces a lightweight tiered trace prioritizer service plus a latency-credit rollup that lets tenants earn short-term "credits" for sub-100ms requests and spend them when they burst, so sampling and alerting are fairer under variable load. Implementation: (1) new telemetry/prioritizer package implements a scoring function combining tenant SLA tier, request latency delta, token-cost estimate, and anomaly score; scores are mapped to probabilistic sampling rates using a configurable sigmoid curve. (2) proxy middleware propagates a Trace-Priority header to downstream services and to the telemetry pipeline. (3) a background aggregator computes per-tenant latency-credit balances and emits rollup metrics (tenant.latency_credits{tenant,region}). (4) dashboards + alert rules to visualize credits, high-priority trace rate, and a tuned P99 drift alert that factors in credits. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind telemetry.tiered_priority (off by default), soft-launch per-region for two weeks, monitor high-priority trace budget. Backwards compatibility: no schema changes to existing spans; when off the system behaves identically to current sampling. Config knobs documented in docs/telemetry/trace-priority.md. Tests: unit tests for scoring, integration test with local proxy harness, dashboard JSON validated with grafana-lint. See commits and files changed for details.

diff_snippets: telemetry/prioritizer/prioritizer.go: func Score(ctx context.Context, meta Meta) float64 { return sigmoid(weightedLatency(meta) + tenantBoost(meta.Tenant)) }

review_comments: Anika Rao: Score function looks good, but can we avoid floating point instability at extreme weights? Recommend clamping and adding deterministic buckets for low-cardinality tenants.
Sofia Martinez: Good point — added clamping and a deterministic bucket fallback for tenants with <1000 invocations/day in prioritizer.go (see commit b2c3d4e).
Marcus Chen: Alert rule is noisy for orgs with frequent small spikes. Suggest factoring in the credit balance and windowing the increase to 15m.
Sofia Martinez: Adjusted alert to check balance==0 and use a 5m increase with a higher threshold; we'll monitor and update if noisy after rollout.
Priya Nair: Docs need an ops section showing how to backfill credit balances for new tenants and how to disable feature per-region.
Sofia Martinez: Added operations subsection and a backfill script example in docs/telemetry/trace-priority.md
